raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The source began sending separate status='REVERSAL' rows (14 rows, linked to originals in the last batches via orig_txn_id) instead of only flagging originals as REVERSED. The silver filter keeps only POSTED rows, so the reversed originals stay in the totals and their reversals are dropped. This inflates gold totals for the latest business days.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": ["CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reversal_amounts AS SELECT CAST(orig_txn_id AS BIGINT) AS orig_txn_id, sum(abs(CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)))) AS rev_amount FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CAST(orig_txn_id AS BIGINT)"], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) - coalesce(r.rev_amount, 0) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t LEFT JOIN reversal_amounts r ON CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) = r.orig_txn_id WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) - coalesce(r.rev_amount, 0) > 0"}}
